metadata.title: Gierer & Meinhardt (1972) Kybernetik 12:30-39 Hydra vulgaris Short-Range Activator / Long-Range Inhibitor Morphogenesis Reference Dataset

sources.citation: Gierer A, Meinhardt H (1972). A theory of biological pattern formation. Kybernetik 12(1):30-39.
Meinhardt H, Gierer A (1974). Applications of a theory of biological pattern formation based on lateral inhibition. Journal of Cell Science 15(2):321-346.

Meinhardt H (1993). A model for pattern formation of hypostome, tentacles, and foot in hydra: how to form structures close to each other, how to form them at a distance. Developmental Biology 157(2):321-333.
Meinhardt H (2012). Modeling pattern formation in hydra: a route to understanding essential steps in development. International Journal of Developmental Biology 56(6-8):447-462.

hydra_vulgaris_specimen.species: Hydra vulgaris (Freshwater cnidarian polyp, dark-field whole-mount showing basal foot, body column, apical hypostome, and 6 radial tentacles)

governing_equations.activator_pde: da/dt = rho_0 * rho(x) + c * rho(x) * a^2 / h - mu_a * a + D_a * d^2a/dx^2
governing_equations.inhibitor_pde: dh/dt = c_prime * rho(x) * a^2 - mu_h * h + D_h * d^2h/dx^2
governing_equations.boundary_conditions: Zero-flux Neumann boundary conditions: da/dx = 0, dh/dx = 0 at x = 0 (apical head) and x = L (basal foot)

linear_stability_invariants.homogeneous_stability_condition: mu_h > mu_a (inhibitor turns over faster than activator so tr(J_0) = mu_a - mu_h < 0 and det(J_0) = mu_a * mu_h > 0)
linear_stability_invariants.lateral_inhibition_range_condition: l_a = sqrt(D_a / mu_a) << l_h = sqrt(D_h / mu_h) (short-range autocatalytic activation coupled with long-range lateral inhibition)

intact_polar_column.description: Gierer & Meinhardt (1972) Fig. 2: Shallow source-density gradient rho(x) = 1.0 * (1 - 0.15 * x/L) triggers a single tall apical hypostome activator peak at x = 0.

bisection_regeneration.description: Gierer & Meinhardt (1972) Fig. 3: Surgical removal of the apical head half (cutting at x = 0.5*L); removal of long-range inhibitor allows the new apical cut end of the basal fragment to regenerate a full hypostome activator peak.

tentacle_ring_periodic.description: Meinhardt (1993) Dev. Biol. 157:321-333: Periodic activator-inhibitor instability around the circular sub-hypostomal ring (circumference C = 50 cells, periodic boundary conditions) forms 6 evenly spaced tentacle primordia matching the adult Hydra vulgaris specimen.

allometric_domain_scaling.description: Peak insertion with domain length L in {20, 35, 50, 65, 80, 95} cells under uniform source density rho(x) = 1.0: number of activator peaks scales linearly with domain length L / lambda_c.

equal_diffusion_negative_control.description: Equal-diffusion ablation control (D_a = D_h = 0.015, d = 1.0 < d_c = 5.8284): random perturbations decay exponentially to the spatially uniform equilibrium with zero pattern peaks.
